summary: Cdecl scalar helper that multiplies a float argument by the global scale factor flt_5DC164 and converts the product to int. The (int) cast truncates toward zero, so the name's "round" is C truncation rather than nearest rounding. Reads the global at 0x005DC164; no callees.

operations.description: Multiply the float argument a1 by the global float scale factor flt_5DC164 (read-only global at 0x005DC164).
Cast the scaled product to int (truncating toward zero) and return it.

unresolved: The value and meaning of the global scale factor flt_5DC164 are not established; it is only read here.
The int cast truncates toward zero, so whether callers depend on rounding vs truncation for negative inputs is unknown.
